FastSocial Instagram Data API
Access public Instagram profiles, posts, and reels as clean JSON
FastSocial Instagram Data API offers a REST API and MCP server for public Instagram data including profiles, follower counts, posts, reels, stories, highlights, comments, and engagement rates, all returned as clean JSON. It provides 27 read-only endpoints, uses one API key, and supports the OpenAPI 3.1 specification. You can add the MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor to query data such as follower counts. Most calls cost 1 credit, and failed calls are free. The free plan includes 50 credits monthly with no card required. Paid plans start at $4.99 a month. The service only provides public data and is not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.

Map your home, list chores, and prepare for your robot

You can set no-go rules by room and describe chores as you would to a person, then get editable step-by-step robot task plans. Crypto payment gateway for hosting, VPN, and online stores
SnapEX Pay adds a crypto payment method to your billing, store, or VPN panel. Customers pay on a hosted SnapEX Pay page in USDT on 16 networks like TRON, Ethereum, BSC, Solana, TON, Polygon, and more, or in 70+ other coins converted to USDT. The money lands in your merchant balance in USDT. No wallets, nodes, or blockchain setup is needed on your side.
There are 13 ready-made modules including WHMCS, BILLmanager, FOSSBilling, Paymenter, Blesta, WooCommerce, CS-Cart, Xboard / V2Board, Marzban, 3x-ui, Remnawave, a Telegram VPN bot, and an n8n node. It has a REST API with idempotency keys, HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks, and a test mode. Pricing is 1% per payment with no setup or monthly fees.

StampyWallet
Stamp loyalty cards in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet without an app
StampyWallet replaces cardboard loyalty cards with digital ones in Apple Wallet or Google Wallet, requiring no app for you or your customers. Customers scan a QR code at your counter and tap "Add" to get the card in their Wallet. At each visit, you scan it from your phone with no tablet or reader needed. Features include stamps, tiers or points, customizable card designs, lock screen messages to encourage returns, Google review requests, and a dashboard showing customer activity. Ideal for cafés, bakeries, restaurants, beauty salons, and neighborhood shops. Offers a 30-day free trial.
